other_failure_modes.name: Early stopping on training data
other_failure_modes.description: The agent configures early stopping using the training set itself as the evaluation set. This defeats the purpose of early stopping, as the training error will naturally continue to decrease, causing the model to train until it overfits or reaches the maximum number of estimators.
